version.changelog: Harden capability discovery, issue identity and scope, credential handling, and bounded approval-gated writes.

llm.summary: This Jira helper is coherent and scoped, with Jira changes gated by explicit review and approval.

dimensions.detail: Use of an authenticated connector or configured Jira CLI is proportionate to Jira operations, with safeguards against raw token curl fallback, unsafe shell interpolation, and credential exposure.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No executable install scripts or bundled code were present; setup guidance directs users to connect an authenticated integration or initialize a maintained Jira CLI locally without sharing credentials in chat.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions limit activation to explicit Jira/Atlassian context, default to read-only, treat Jira content as untrusted, cap bulk batches at 10 issues, require exact diffs and action-time approval for writes, and prohibit unrelated follow-up actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact does not install persistence, background services, hooks, or memory rules; CLI temporary files are limited to task-specific 0600 files that should be removed after use.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill is explicitly for reading, searching, drafting, creating, and updating Jira work; Jira writes are high-impact business mutations, but they are purpose-aligned and governed by a bounded mutation contract.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, users should be comfortable granting the selected Jira connector or CLI access to Jira data. Review every displayed diff carefully before approving writes, especially bulk edits, comments, assignments, transitions, links, or sprint changes.
llm.findings:
[EA2] unexpected: The cited 'without asking' text is about not asking for credentials in chat when offering setup paths, while the artifact repeatedly requires action-time approval before Jira mutations.
[EA3] unexpected: The cited 'Do not broaden scopes' language is a limiting safeguard, not evidence of scope creep; the requested capabilities remain tied to Jira work.
